lines.text: 6 A.M. Espresso machine's warming up, the line's out the door... and I still haven't posted today's special.
Hey! I saw your post. Is the maple oat latte still on today?
Wait... it already posted? Photo, caption and all?
Behind the scenes: every morning the bot takes the special from your menu sheet, writes the post, and lines it up. You tap approve.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Comment BREW and we'll show you how we build it. You're still the captain.
